description: Inventaire du Patrimoine Immobilier Culturel Wallonie is a dataset listed in Open Data Wallonie Bruxelles, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a region, department, metropolitan area or agency, published or maintained by Service public de Wallonie (SPW). Le jeu de données reprend la localisation ainsi que la fiche d’identification des biens repris à l’Inventaire du Patrimoine Immobilier Culturel. L'Inventaire a pour objectifs la connaissance, la protection et la gestion des biens inscrits, ainsi que la sensibilisation du public. Coverage: Wallonia and Brussels. The portal files it under Tourisme, Culture, Sport et Loisirs, Urbanisme, Patrimoine. Its keywords are Patrimoine, Culturel, Immobilier. The portal shows 28,934 records. It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal shows 2019-02-13 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC BY (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support building stock, energy use and retrofit studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-www-odwb-be-portal.
